high_level_description: The image depicts two women standing together at what appears to be a formal event or gathering. The setting is outdoors, under a large white canopy structure that provides shade. The background shows other attendees mingling and some tables with floral arrangements and plates of food, suggesting a social or celebratory occasion. The woman on the left has shoulder-length straight brown hair and is wearing a black tweed dress with a white collar and cuffs. She has a buttoned front and a fitted silhouette. She accessorizes with multiple rings on her fingers and a bracelet on her wrist.
